data.title: Robinhood Advances 5%, Webull Ticks Up as Bitcoin's Breakout Lifts Retail Brokerages
data.description: Bitcoin's sharp breakout is sending shockwaves through retail brokerage stocks, but Robinhood and Webull are catching the move in very different ways, and the gap between them reveals something important about how each company is actually built.
data.author: David Moadel
